from omegaconf import OmegaConf

# Step 1: Fetch framework's default parameter set
from pocket_coffea.parameters import default_parameters as framework_defaults
params = OmegaConf.create(framework_defaults)

# Step 2: Overlay YAML files in sequence (later files override earlier ones)
for yaml_file in ["params/object_preselection.yaml", "params/triggers.yaml"]:
    yaml_config = OmegaConf.load(yaml_file)
    params = OmegaConf.merge(params, yaml_config)
